description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the Shortcut module, including help text, toolbar modifications, theme installation handling, and user deletion cleanup.

classes.name: ShortcutHooks
classes.description: Class implementing Drupal hooks for the Shortcut module, including help, toolbar, theme installation, and user deletion hooks.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information and shortcut set options based on route name.

methods.name: toolbar
methods.description: Adds a shortcuts toolbar item for users with permission.

methods.name: themesInstalled
methods.description: Sets a configuration setting when the Claro theme is installed.

methods.name: userDelete
methods.description: Unassigns shortcut sets from a user upon user deletion.
